description: Parity scenarios for the OpenAlgo REST client and strategy webhook sender. See README.md for the argument encoding.

scenarios.note: Extra kwargs are str()-converted: 750.5 -> '750.5', 123456789 -> '123456789', True -> 'True'.
str() of a float uses the shortest round-trip repr.
A None kwarg is skipped.
Missing required argument raises in every language.
A one-element orders list must still be sent as a JSON array.
order_id is sent as given (no str()), kwargs are str()-converted.

json.message: Canceled 2 orders. Failed to cancel 0 orders.

scenarios.note: Python raises AttributeError inside _handle_response and reports it as unknown_error.
In the combined api class the OrderAPI response handler wins the MRO, so the message is 'HTTP 400: <body>' and not the body's own message.
OrderAPI handler wins the MRO: no 'Error processing response' prefix.
Numbers go out as JSON numbers; stoploss and target are sent as null for SINGLE.
A zero stoploss counts as missing; target None too.
_post keeps the server body and adds code.
setdefault keeps an existing status even on a non-200.
_post returns a 200 error body untouched (no code, no error_type).

json.message: Live trading is not enabled for this strategy

scenarios.note: mode is required and never defaulted.
Data kwargs are passed as-is (no str()).
A falsy exchange is omitted from the payload.
Unsorted rows with a duplicate timestamp (the duplicate carries different values); the first occurrence wins after a stable sort; intraday is converted to Asia/Kolkata.
D/W/M timestamps stay naive (no timezone).

All exchanges in order; NFO 500, BFO api error, MCX empty, CDS non-JSON, NSE_INDEX timeout, BSE_INDEX array body are skipped. BSE adds an extra column, so the combined frame is the column union with nulls.
quantity/price/trigger_price are stringified; missing price and trigger_price become '0'.
Fields other than quantity/price/trigger_price pass through untouched (lots stays a number).
optiongreeks passes values as-is (numbers stay numbers).
strike_int is deprecated: a warning is emitted and it is sent as a string.
Two deprecation warnings (strategy and strike_int).
Leg quantity int(), price/trigger_price float(), disclosed_quantity int(); unknown leg keys are dropped; strike_int int() with a warning; kwargs as-is.
strategy has no default on optionsmultiorder.
strike_count int(); kwargs as-is.
A one-element list still means phones (R list(), MATLAB cell array).
username wins over to.
message omitted: no message key.
A kwarg whose key is already in the payload is ignored.
Default date is today in local time; only its format is compared.
Python does not strip a trailing slash: the path becomes //api/v1/funds.
leg_id is int()-converted.
Trailing slash on host_url is stripped.
Constructing without a token raises.
Removed method raises.
Strategy.send reports any non-JSON body as http_error, even on 200.
